scope: Selected locally generated DXF HATCH and boundary graphs, ordinary same-version DXF and AC1018 DWG output in LibreCAD on macOS ARM64.
finding: An imported associative HATCH with no usable source handle was omitted from the deassociation loss count; its named boundary could retain a dangling reactor. A copied HATCH duplicated the undercount.
change: Retain association provenance on the hatch through copies; remember unidentified source boundaries across hatch deletion and cross-document copies; refuse saves with unresolved or ambiguous selected boundary reactors, recheck at finalization, preserve the destination, and provide a repair message. Retain uniquely identified POINT, LINE, CIRCLE and ARC targets in the checked ordinary profile; advanced-object graphs remain guarded.

checks.name: System codec focused HATCH association selectors
Bundled codec focused HATCH association selectors
AddressSanitizer system-codec selector
checks.limits: Qt leak detection disabled; linked system codec was not instrumented.

checks.name: Independent DXF graph and audit
checks.details: Direct DXF and libdxfrw DWG-to-DXF readback, for both codecs; checks deassociation, boundary reactors, output identity uniqueness where applicable, target kinds and clean audits.

coverage: Handleless import, valid non-associative control, copy and cross-document paste, removed hatch, missing and duplicate targets, typed-dictionary collision, unsupported target and advanced-object guard; preflight and selected late-mutation failures preserve the destination and permit corrected retry. R12 refusal/retry is checked separately.
limits: The source with an absent HATCH handle is a locally authored malformed/recovery control, not a qualified producer file.

HATCH loops remain reconstructed and non-associative. This does not establish associative editing, arbitrary object targets, complete metadata collision detection, general graph closure or native CAD behavior.
The late check covers newly unresolved boundary references; it is not a full immutable snapshot of all drawing edits.
DWG output was read by libdxfrw and then independently audited as DXF, not independently decoded as DWG. Linux/Windows and native GUI qualification are pending.
No generated DXF or DWG fixture was committed.
